records.question: Tom turned 32 years old 5 years ago.  7 years ago Jim was 5 years older than half Tom's age.  How old is Jim in 2 years?
records.response:
32 years ago, Tom was 32-5 = 27 years old.
7 years ago, Tom was 27-7 = 20 years old.
Half of Tom's age 7 years ago was 20/2 = 10 years old.
So, 7 years ago, Jim was 5+10 = 15 years old.
Therefore, Jim's age in 2 years is 15+2 = 17 years old.
#### 17

records.question: A company has 100 employees. 60% of the employees drive to work. Of the employees who don't drive to work, half take public transportation.  How many employees use public transportation to get to work?
records.response:
60% of 100 employees is 60 * 100 / 100 = 60 employees drive to work.
Therefore, 100 - 60 = 40 employees don't drive to work.
Half of these employees take public transportation, so 40 / 2 = 20 employees use public transportation to get to work.
